description: This file defines a PHP class 'PimDefinedReportAPI' implementing CRUD API endpoints for managing PIM-defined reports in a Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for listing, creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting reports, utilizing validation, transaction management, and external services.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportAPI
classes.description: A PHP class providing REST API endpoints for managing Personal Identity Management (PIM) reports, supporting CRUD operations with validation and transaction management in an HRM system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all defined PIM reports, with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new PIM report based on provided parameters, validating inputs and setting report properties.

methods.name: setParamsToPimDefinedReport
methods.description: Populates a Report entity with data from request parameters, setting its name and report group.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the getAll endpoint parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified reports by IDs, handling validation and response with deleted IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Defines validation rules for delete operation parameters.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific report by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for retrieving a single report.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing report by ID with new data, handling transactions and validation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the update operation.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Provides common validation rules for request bodies across create and update methods.
